task-code-baseline-source.help: Choose an exact accepted agent candidate or composition result for this unstarted task. This fixes its code input; it does not start development or grant acceptance.
task-code-baseline-source.bounded: This reads up to 200 source entries. It is not a complete project history; multiple producer steps are separate choices.
task-code-baseline-source.empty: No candidate in this loaded scope currently qualifies for a new baseline binding.
task-code-baseline-source.changed: The selected source changed or its current qualification is unconfirmed. Refresh and explicitly select the candidate again.
task-code-baseline-source.open_source: Open the exact source run and attempt
task-code-baseline-source.pending_source: Original request: {{task}} · v{{version}} · {{node}}. Reconcile this request even if the candidate is no longer listed.
